page_title: FRE 2-0 AUG | Freiburg v Augsburg 01/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Michael Gregoritsch almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Junior Adamu (Freiburg) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+1' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' A rebound falls at the feet of Patric Pfeiffer (Augsburg) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar.
89' Christian Streich has decided to make a change. Manuel Gulde (Freiburg) replaces Roland Sallai.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) comes onto the pitch so that Lucas Holer can be given a rest.
84' Sven Michel (Augsburg) takes out his opponent with a nasty challenge and is relieved when the referee only gives him a booking.
82' The goal by Augsburg is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
81' The Augsburg players halt their celebrations as referee Harm Osmers makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

80' It's a goal! Ermedin Demirovic plays the ball to the feet of Sven Michel (Augsburg), who hits a tremendous first-time shot into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was unable to keep it out. 2:1.
79' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Arne Maier (Augsburg) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
79' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. A free kick has been awarded to Augsburg.
79' Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg) takes the resultant free kick from distance and swings it into the box, but the goalkeeper climbs high to collect the ball.

78' Arne Maier (Augsburg) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Harm Osmers blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. A free kick is awarded to Freiburg.
77' The attendance for today's match is 33134.
75' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
73' Here's the change. Vincenzo Grifo leaves the pitch and Junior Adamu (Freiburg) comes on as a substitute.
73' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ritsu Doan as he is replaced by Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg).
71' Enrico Maassen has decided to substitute Tim Breithaupt and he is replaced by Arne Maier (Augsburg).
71' The game has come to an end for Phillip Tietz. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Dion Beljo (Augsburg).
70' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Finn Dahmen scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post.
67' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) misses the left post by a whisker with a close-range rebound. What a chance that was!
67' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) will take a corner kick.

66' A neat pass is well received by Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot. The ball is out of play. Augsburg will have a chance to score from a corner.
65' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Noah Atubolu comes off the line to clear the ball away.
62' The ball is cleared after Sven Michel (Augsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
60' Tim Breithaupt (Augsburg) has tested the patience of referee Harm Osmers and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
59' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
57' Enrico Maassen decides to make a substitution. Ruben Vargas will be replaced by Sven Michel (Augsburg).
57' Substitution. Iago is replaced by Mads Pedersen (Augsburg).

56' 2 - 0 Vincenzo Grifo sends in a great cross from the corner and finds Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg), who outjumps the defence to put the ball into the roof of the net with a stunning header. The score is 2:0.
56' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

56' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. Freiburg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
53' Harm Osmers blows his whistle as Patric Pfeiffer (Augsburg) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
52' The free kick is taken by Ruben Vargas (Augsburg), but ball is cleared.
50' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
48' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
47' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Finn Dahmen intercepts the ball.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Harm Osmers blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) flashes a in volley from just outside the box, but it goes well wide of the left post. The goalkeeper can stay calm.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
44' The corner from Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is hurriedly cleared.
43' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
41' Harm Osmers blows his whistle after Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
40' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
32' Harm Osmers blows his whistle and signals a foul after Tim Breithaupt (Augsburg) brought his opponent down.
29' Augsburg string together a series of short passes.
26' The total number of attempts is 2:5. Shots on target – 2:3.

21' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the right post.
20' Christian Streich is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Yannik Keitel (Freiburg) suffers an injury and Merlin Rohl comes on.
20' Yannik Keitel (Freiburg) picks up an injury.
19' Poor challenge! Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) is penalised for tripping and Harm Osmers blows his whistle. Augsburg are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

16' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
12' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Finn Dahmen.
10' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
10' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

9' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Noah Atubolu anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom left corner.
9' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) meets a cross inside the box, but Noah Atubolu wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
5' 1 - 0 Goal! Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Finn Dahmen into the top right corner.
5' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is going to take the penalty!
5' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
4' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Freiburg as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
3' Iago (Augsburg) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. PENALTY to Freiburg! Let's see who will take responsibility.
1' The first half has just begun.
Augsburg will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Harm Osmers.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
